dogecoin.text: @rovercrc This is a significant development! A spot ETF for Dogecoin could set a precedent for how memecoins are perceived in the broader financial ecosystem. It raises intriguing questions about the legitimacy and future of memecoins as investment vehicles.
The filing for a Dogecoin ETF by Bitwise is a significant milestone. It signals growing institutional interest in memecoins, which could reshape perceptions in the broader crypto market.
